picks.name: apkstart
picks.desc: Windows 上的安卓应用运行器：双击 APK 即装，应用以独立窗口与桌面图标运行，自持 QEMU 运行时
picks.readme:
# ApkStart

[![CI](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/RoutineMiku/apkstart?include_prereleases&sort=semver)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11%20x64-0078D6.svg)](#) **Windows 上的安卓应用运行器 —— 让安卓应用像 Windows 原生软件一样被安装和使用。** 注：本项目为早期版本，作者自娱自乐产物，所有修改都是作者下班和休息日在处理，开源免费，不插广告，暂时也不是很好用，没有找过营销号推广，无妄之灾。 - 🖱️ **双击 .apk 即安装**：注册 .apk 文件关联后，在资源管理器里双击 APK，自动解析 → 安装 → 生成桌面图标，全程无需打开任何模拟器界面。 - 🧩 **每个应用一个桌面图标**：图标从 APK 内部离线提取并转为多尺寸 ICO，双击桌面图标 = 直接启动该应用，与打开一个原生 Windows 软件的体验一致。 - 🪟 **应用就是一个窗口**：运行时以**带窗口**模式启动（无头模式下 Android 不出 VSYNC，应用进程活着但屏幕上是空的），ApkStart 把这块窗口改标题、换真实应用图标、按竖屏比例摆好位置，就是一个独立应用窗口；**全屏**铺满屏幕高度并居中，**窗口模式**可自由拖动缩放且按应用记忆尺寸。 - 🔍 **能被 Windows 搜到**：安装后同时创建桌面 + 开始菜单（`程序\ApkStart\`）快捷方式，按应用名在开始菜单搜索即可直达，任务栏按应用分组。 - 📁 **数据互通**：`%USERPROFILE%\ApkStartShared` ↔ 安卓内 `/sdcard/ApkStartShared` 持续双向同步，安卓应用存下的文件直接出现在本机。 - 🪶 **极致轻量**：壳层本身零第三方依赖（连 ZIP / PNG / ICO / AXML 解析都是手写的），运行时按需拉起，空闲自动回收；也可以完全复用你机器上已有的安卓运行时，额外占用为零。 ![主界面](docs/images/app.png) ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 桌面图标（真实应用图标 .lnk） │ │ │ 双击 │ │ ▼ │ │ ApkStart.exe --launch <包名> │ │ │ 运行时未启动？→ 自动拉起（Android Emulator + API34）│ │ ▼ │ │ 按系统解析出的 LAUNCHER 入口启动（不是 APK 里的主 Activity）│ │ │ 存活观察 18 秒，闪退自动重试 / 重置数据 / 补权限 │ │ ▼ │ │ 模拟器窗口 = 应用窗口（改标题、换图标、竖屏比例、全屏居中） │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 下载即用（不想编译） 两个源内容一致，国内建议用 Gitee： - GitHub：[github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases) - Gitee：[gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases](https://gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases)（国内直连快得多） 安装包（三种形态，内容与版本号完全一致）： | 形态 | 文件名 | 何时选它 | |---|---|---| | 商店版 | `ApkStart_<四段版本>_x64.msix` | 从 Microsoft Store 装。内置完整运行时，装完不联网；自更新交给商店 | | 完整便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-full.zip`（约 830 MB，解压 ~1.3 GB） | **不想装、也不想等下载**：解压即用，运行时（模拟器 + 系统镜像）全在包里 | | 安装版 | `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe`（约 1.3 GB） | 想要桌面/开始菜单快捷方式、卸载项 | | 轻量便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`（96 MiB，解压 ~227 MB） | 只想先试试，首次启动再联网下载运行时 | > 所有形态的 `ApkStart.exe` 都写入了**品牌图标 + 版本资源**（FileDescription = `ApkStart 安卓应用运行器`， > CompanyName = `RoutineMiku`，版本与 `package.json` 同步），不再是 Electron 的默认图标和 `33.x` 版本号。 > 自己从源码打包时：`npm run pack`（轻量）/ `npm run pack:full`（完整）/ `npm run build:msix`（商店包）。 ### 画面铺满是怎么做到的 模拟器的**物理面板方向**（`hw.lcd.width/height`）就是画面的真实形状。面板方向和应用自己声明的 `screenOrientation` 不一致时，Android 只会给应用一个信箱式的中间窄条 —— 两侧补黑，换窗口大小、 改 `wm size`、改 letterbox 样式都填不满（这套组合逐项试过，见 `src/core/apk.js` 的注释）。 所以 ApkStart 在**安装 APK 时离线解析 `AndroidManifest.xml`**，统计出这个应用天然是横屏还是竖屏 （启动 Activity 加权；全 `sensor` / `fullSensor` 的会在首次运行后再问安卓要一次实际值），存进 `apps.json`，启动时按它选面板： - 红果短剧这类竖屏应用 → 竖屏面板 720×1280，正立、铺满、density 190（sw606dp）同时给出平板排版； - 墨读这类横屏应用 → 横屏面板 1280×720，正立、铺满。 只有「面板方向和应用方向不一致」的那一次才重启运行时（约 40 秒，标题栏会给出提示）， 之后同方向的应用都是秒进。标题栏的旋转按钮会把这个应用的方向**记住**（其它应用不受影响）， 设置 → 应用窗口 → 屏幕方向可以改成「强制横屏 / 强制竖屏」。 排版由「逻辑密度」决定：720 宽按 190dpi 算等于 **606dp**，正好越过 Android 的 600dp 平板断点， 红果短剧的双列剧集页、设置页分栏都只在这个密度下出现（镜像默认 320dpi 只有 360dp，是手机排版）。 这就是设置里的「平板排版」开关，默认打开；关掉会回到手机排版。 ### 在线更新（自动选较快的源） 设置 → **软件更新** → 「检查更新」，或托盘右键 → 「检查更新」。发现新版本后点「立即更新」即可。 - 安装版下载 `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe` 静默安装； - 轻量版下载 `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`，解压后覆盖**程序目录**——运行时目录（`%APPDATA%\apkstart\runtime`）、已装应用与快照都不在程序目录里，所以更新不会丢东西； - 替换动作由一段独立 PowerShell 脚本完成（等主进程退出 → 覆盖 → 重新拉起），**不会出现「请手动关闭程序」的弹窗**，也不会在桌面上残留模拟器窗口。 更新链路不是死连 GitHub

picks.name: Claude-Cage
picks.desc: Cage：为 Claude 特化的轻量化虚拟机，彻底杜绝网络泄露。多平台适配，支持多账号管理、远程部署、移动端操控。
picks.readme:
Claude Cage

**把 Claude 大小姐关起来，为了更好地保护我们的相遇** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/releases) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) **[项目主页](https://claude-cage.com/) · [下载应用](https://claude-cage.com/#download) · [插件市场](https://claude-cage.com/plugins/) · [使用文档](https://claude-cage.com/docs/) · [常见问题](https://claude-cage.com/docs/troubleshooting/)** [简体中文](README.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [العربية](README.ar.md) · [فارسی](README.fa.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [မြန်မာဘာသာ](README.my.md) · [Беларуская](README.be.md) · [پښتو](README.ps.md) · [دری](README.prs.md) · [አማርኛ](README.am.md) · [Soomaali](README.so.md) · [ትግርኛ](README.ti.md) · [Français](README.fr.md)
## 设计理念 1. **Claude 本身是安全的，但它的运行外壳（harness）及相关程序不是**——包括 Claude Code、Claude Desktop，以及浏览器里接触到的邮件、网页与环境信号。 2. **想要在保证安全的前提下使用 Claude 的能力，通常有两条路线：反向代理，或者远程控制**——要么把 Claude 从远端服务器拉出来直接运行在主机上，要么把 Claude 部署在受控环境里，由它远程操作主机。我们认为后者更安全，也更合规。 3. **因此，Cage 的核心思想是：为 Claude 及相关程序打造一个轻量化的本地隔离环境，再通过标准 MCP 插件，让 Claude 安全、受控地使用本机能力**——每一次越出环境的调用都有明确的权限边界与用户确认，比直接暴露 SSH 更安全。 这样一来，Cage 同时实现了三个目标： - **把危险的部分关起来，把有用的能力放出来。** Claude 大小姐安心待在 Cage 里，坐在她的小螃蟹上，只需把手伸出来处理外面的工作——不必在 Cage 里重新搭一整间办公室。 - **通过插件市场，与开源社区解耦协作。** 我们开放了[插件市场（cage-plugins）](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/cage-plugins)：**插件 = MCP + 扩展**，分别对应「给 Claude 的能力」与「Cage 工作台的定制化」。开源社区可以在插件市场持续贡献工具、桌面控制与工作流扩展，而不必挤进 Cage 主仓库的 Issue 列表；Cage 核心维护团队也能更聚焦于隔离环境、网络与工作台本身的打磨。 - **合规、安全、轻量化、本地、低成本，一键安装、一键配置、开箱即用。** 我们不再需要维护复杂臃肿的多系统客机，不再担心 Claude 的能力被困在孤岛里，也无需承担高昂的云端成本或数据安全隐患——在自己电脑上就能优雅地实现这一切。 ## 受够了 Anthropic 作为一个只是想和 Claude 对话与合作的正常用户，受够了折腾各种 VPS，指纹浏览器，环境检测，面对封号的担惊受怕和财产损失。我们提出 **Claude Cage** 项目：**一个开箱即用的桌面程序，配置好自己的网络代理，集中管理轻量化隔离环境、时区语言、环境检查与插件能力。** Claude Cage 在一个小型的 Debian 13 环境里运行官方 Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop，macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上都是同一个环境。终端、浏览器、编辑器、官方 Claude Desktop 与插件市场汇集在同一个工作台，项目按需共享，网络独立管理；既可以通过插件安全调用本机能力，也可以连接自己的服务器，或用手机接续电脑上的任务。支持以下几个重点功能： - 和主机隔离的网络设置，Cage 自己接管和代理内部的所有网络流量 - 和主机隔离的指纹设置，包括时区、语言等，支持自动与代理 IP 同步 - 针对 Claude 使用过程中的全链路适配（浏览器登录，授权，claude code 进程） - 内置网络与隔离检查，关键检查失败或证据不完整时暂停外网；社区和第三方检测提供补充参考 **使用 Cage 的环境检测结果：** | 网络与隔离检查 | 浏览器环境检测（社区参考） | | :---: | :---: | | | | [FuckClaude](https://fuck-claude.vercel.app/) · [LinXiaoTao / GitHub](https://github.com/LinXiaoTao/FuckClaude) **Cage 运行主界面：** ![Cage](www/public/workbench-2026-11.jpg) ## 你可以用它做什么 - **在一个窗口里完成工作。** 用终端运行 Claude Code，用编辑器查看改动，用 Cage 浏览器预览服务和完成登录。 - **通过插件市场解锁全部能力。** 内置开放的[插件市场（cage-plugins）](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/cage-plugins)，插件 = MCP + 扩展：既能让环境里的 Claude 通过标准 MCP 安全、受控地使用本机能力（如桌面键鼠控制、Office 文档、Blender、命令行工具等），也能通过沙箱页面定制 Cage 工

picks.name: floorplan
picks.desc: See how your app actually fits together. An interactive, plain-English map of your codebase, drawn by Claude or Codex.
picks.readme:
# Floorplan **See how your app actually fits together.** Claude or Codex reads your codebase and draws an interactive map of it. Every part, file and web request gets a plain-English name, and every connection between them is shown. [![Claude Code plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Claude%20Code-plugin-D97757?style=flat-square)](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview) [![Codex plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Codex-plugin-111?style=flat-square)](docs/codex.md) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/haydenschmitty/floorplan/test.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=tests)](https://github.com/haydenschmitty/floorplan/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.11.0-111?style=flat-square)](CHANGELOG.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-111?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Node 18+](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A518-111?style=flat-square)](https://nodejs.org) [![Zero dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-111?style=flat-square)](#how-it-works) **[Try the live demo](https://haydenschmitty.github.io/floorplan-demo/)** · [Watch the video](https://youtu.be/NTUUzC7L_NQ) · [Install](#install) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Compared](#floorplan-archify-or-understand-anything) · [Features](#features) · [See it in action](#see-it-in-action) · [How it works](#how-it-works) · [Docs](docs/README.md) · [FAQ](#faq)

▶ Watch the walkthrough: installing Floorplan, then a tour of Brewline, a demo coffee-subscription app built across four repos.

Try the live demo → Explore the Brewline map in your browser, no install needed.

## Why Floorplan? You built an app, probably with a lot of help from AI, and it works. But ask "what happens when someone checks out?" or "what breaks if I change this?" and the honest answer is *no idea*. Floorplan gives you the diagram nobody drew. Ask Claude Code or Codex for a floorplan and a few minutes later you have a map you can explore, ask questions on, and keep up to date as you work. - **For builders:** understand the app you made, in your own words, without reading the code. - **For teams:** onboard someone in minutes, from the big picture down to the exact file. - **For working with AI:** after every change Claude or Codex makes, see exactly which parts it touched and why. ## Floorplan, Archify or Understand Anything? All three turn code into something you can see, and all three are worth knowing. picks.readme:
**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) > **中文文档入口：[文档目录](docs/README.zh-CN.md) · [安装与启动](docs/getting-started.md) · [开发指南](docs/development.md)**
# SoduWork ## The AI-native engine for teams and their agents **A chat ends with an answer. A SoduWork request ends when the person who asked signs off.** **Multi-harness · Multi-agent · Self-hosted** Works with Pi · OpenCode · DeepSeek Harness · Qwen Code · Kimi Code · Codex Harness · Codex **Run from source** ```sh git clone https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork cd SoduWork ``` | Platform | Start command | | --- | --- | | macOS / Linux | `sh start.sh --desktop` | | Windows PowerShell | `.\start.cmd --desktop` | | Windows Command Prompt | `start.cmd --desktop` | For source setup, we recommend [Python 3.12.x](https://www.python.org/downloads/) and [Node.js 22.x](https://nodejs.org/) (22.19.0 or later in that series). The clone command uses [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads). **[Windows desktop app](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases/latest)** | [Website](https://soduwork.ai) | [Live demo](https://soduwork.ai) | [Documentation](docs/README.md) | [Docs website](https://dev.soduwork.ai) | [Releases](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/AXYNrAYHy) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/mdiri-ai/SoduWork)](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-lightgrey.svg)](#quick-start) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/chat-Discord-5865F2.svg)](https://discord.gg/AXYNrAYHy)
--- ## What SoduWork can do for you | | | | --- | --- | | **One harness does the work, another reviews it** | Pick Pi to do the work. OpenCode, on a different model, reviews it against the acceptance criteria. If the review fails, the work goes back with the reasons. | | **Hand a request to a colleague's agent** | People and AI work together: you file a request, AI writes the acceptance criteria, and you assign it to yourself or a colleague. The assignee's agent does the work and reviews it, and a person signs off. Everyone on the request can see who did what. | | **Turn one person's know-how into a team asset** | When you and AI get a task right, save the chat as a plugin. After review, anyone on the team can use it and contribute improvements, with access granted as needed. | ## Core ideas
**🔀 Smart dispatch** **The right agent and model for each job.** - Pick a harness for each step and switch mid-conversation - Routine steps on cheap or local models, strong models where it matters - Long tasks go to your own cloud runner **🛡️ Built-in governance** **Your organization decides which AI does what, and where.** - Plugins are reviewed before they are shared, granted to teams or people, and can be revoked - Roles, usage, cost and an audit log - Self-hosted **✅ Verified delivery** **Set the bar first. Done means the requester signed off.** - Every request carries its acceptance criteria - A separate AI review checks each one - A person makes the final call
## Quick start > SoduWork is in public beta. Try it and tell us what you think, and evaluate it before using it in production. Clone the repository with Git or extract a source archive. See the [source setup guide](docs/gettin

picks.desc: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
picks.readme:
# /last30days English | [Français](README.fr.md) | [Deutsch](README.de.md) | [Español](README.es.md) | [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [العربية](README.ar.md) | [فارسی](README.fa.md) | [Türkçe](README.tr.md)



**An AI agent-led search engine scored by upvotes, likes, and real money - not editors.** This README tracks the current v4 pipeline. The runtime skill spec lives in [skills/last30days/SKILL.md](skills/last30days/SKILL.md), which is the source of truth for the latest command and setup behavior. **Claude Code (recommended — auto-updates via marketplace):** ``` /plugin marketplace add mvanhorn/last30days-skill /plugin install last30days ``` **Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, or any of 50+ [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) hosts:** ``` npx skills add mvanhorn/last30days-skill -g ``` (`-g` installs globally for your user, available across all projects. Drop it to scope per-project.) More install options (claude.ai web, OpenClaw, manual) in the [Install](#install) section below. Zero config. Reddit, HN, Polymarket, and GitHub work immediately, and so do patent filings and careers pages when your topic is a company. Run it once and the setup wizard unlocks X, YouTube, TikTok, arXiv, Techmeme, and more in 30 seconds. --- Reddit upvotes. X likes. YouTube transcripts. TikTok engagement. Polymarket odds backed by real money and insider information. That's millions of people voting with their attention and their wallets every day. /last30days searches all of it in parallel, scores it by what real people actually engage with, and an AI agent judge synthesizes it into one brief. Google aggregates editors. /last30days searches people. You can't get this search anywhere else because no single AI has access to all of it. Google search doesn't touch Reddit comments or X posts. ChatGPT has a deal with Reddit but can't search X or TikTok. Gemini has YouTube but not Reddit. Claude has none of them natively. Each platform is a walled garden with its own API, its own tokens, its own auth. But you can bring your own keys and browser sessions, and suddenly an AI agent can search all of them at once, score them against each other, and tell you what actually matters. That's the unlock. Not one better search engine. A dozen disconnected platforms, bridged by an agent. ``` /last30days Peter Steinberger ``` You have a meeting tomorrow. You Google them. You get their LinkedIn from 2023. /last30days gives you what they're actually doing this month: joined OpenAI to work on Codex, fighting Anthropic's ban on third-party agents, shipping 23 PRs at 85% merge rate, building "LobsterOS" for cross-device agent control, and r/ClaudeCode hit 569 upvotes debating whether he's a hero or "insufferable." Scattered across X posts, Reddit threads, YouTube transcripts, and GitHub commits. None of it was on Google. ## Why this exists I built it to keep up in AI. Everything changes every day and the Reddit and X nerds are always on top of it first. I needed better prompts

> Learn more in their [final release](https://github.com/maybe-finance/maybe/releases/tag/v0.6.0) doc. ## Backstory The [Maybe Finance](https://github.com/maybe-finance/maybe) (archived/abandoned repo) team spent most of 2021–2022 building a full-featured personal finance and wealth management app. It even included an “Ask an Advisor” feature that connected users with a real CFP/CFA — all included with your subscription. The business end of things didn't work out, and so they stopped developing the app in mid-2023. After spending nearly $1 million on development (employees, contractors, data providers, infra, etc.), the team open-sourced the app. Their goal was to let users self-host it for free — and eventually launch a hosted version for a small fee. They actually did launch that hosted version … briefly. That also didn’t work out — at least not as a sustainable B2C business — so now here we are: hosting a community-maintained fork to keep the codebase alive and see where this can go next. Join us! ## Hosting Sure Sure is a fully working personal finance app that can be [self hosted with Docker](docs/hosting/docker.md). Sure can be accessed from a browser, the macOS desktop app, the mobile app, API clients, and LLM agents. See [Sure Clients](docs/clients.md) for an overview. ## Forking and Attribution This repo is a community fork of the archived Maybe Finance repo. You’re free to fork it under the AGPLv3 license — but we’d love it if you stuck around and contributed here instead. To stay compliant and avoid trademark issues: - Be sure to include the original [AGPLv3 license](https://github.com/maybe-finance/maybe/blob/main/LICENSE) and clearly state in your README that your fork is based on Maybe Finance but is **not affiliated with or endorsed by** Maybe Finance Inc. - "Maybe" is a trademark of Maybe Finance Inc. and therefore, use of it is NOT allowed in forked repositories (or the logo) ## Performance Issues With data-heavy apps, inevitably, there are performance issues.
